_caps_note: Daily cap per bot (USD/day, UTC day). EMPTY = no limit (unlimited) for all bots until the owner sets one. global_cap_usd=null means no global cap. Example: "caps": {"yt-scriptwriter": 2.00}. Or env: GROKBOT_DAILY_CAP_USD=5 (global) / GROKBOT_DAILY_CAP_USD_YT_SCRIPTWRITER=2 (per bot).
_comment: Shipped defaults for the cost ledger (costs/). Edit the RUNTIME file data/cost_settings.json (or env vars) — never this file — to change prices or caps. Keys starting with "_" are notes and ignored.
_prices_note: ESTIMASI: USD per 1M token (tarif publik per Okt 2026). Provider BYO bisa menagih berbeda — cost_usd di ledger adalah perkiraan, bukan tagihan. Model yang tidak ada di tabel: token tetap dicatat, biaya 0, flag price_known=false.
